findings.issue: GET /books/:id/reviews never validates the book exists, unlike the sibling /books/:id/histogram route added in the same diff which returns 404 for a missing book.
findings.evidence: router.get('/books/:id/reviews', ...) calls Stats.getReviewsSorted(bookId, sort) and responds 200 with an empty array for a nonexistent/malformed book id, while the /books/:id/histogram route right below it guards with `if (!Book.getBookById(bookId)) return res.status(404)...`

findings.issue: GET /books/top silently overrides an explicit limit=0 to the default of 10 instead of clamping it to the minimum of 1.
findings.evidence: const limit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) || 10, 1), 50); — `parseInt('0',10) || 10` turns the falsy 0 into 10 before the Math.max(...,1) clamp ever runs.
